tab.description: Construction assemblies, opening types, and the elements that reference them. The editor manages the "before" (baseline) scenario.
tab.emptyDescription: Define construction types, opening types, and envelope elements to enable heat-loss calculations for this building.

editor.title: Edit envelope — "Before" scenario
editor.description: Saving replaces all "before" scenario building blocks, construction types, opening types, and envelope elements for this building. Construction and opening types are referenced by the code you give them below — element rows and openings pick their type from those codes.

buildingBlocks.title: Building blocks
buildingBlocks.stepDescription: The building's parts (e.g. separate wings) — each one's footprint and floor count. Used in the next step to assign facades to a block.
buildingBlocks.name: Name *

constructionTypes.title: Construction types
constructionTypes.stepDescription: Reusable layer recipes (e.g. "W1 wall"). The U-value is computed live as you add layers.
constructionTypes.noMaterials: No materials in the reference catalog yet — layers can't be added until materials are seeded.

openingTypes.title: Opening types
openingTypes.stepDescription: Reusable window/door catalog. Define each type once, then reference it repeatedly on facades in the next step.

elements.title: Facades
elements.stepDescription: Each side (P1, P2, ...) is collapsed into one group — containing parts like wall and socle. The panel above shows a live running total, so you can cross-check against your Excel/measurements immediately.
